Design electrical systems, including power distribution, electrical load calculations, lighting and emergency lighting, cable trays, conduits, and containment systems, low-current and ELV systems, and electrical equipment and service rooms. Coordinate mechanical and electrical designs with architectural, structural, plumbing, fire protection, and other engineering disciplines. Perform interdisciplinary clash detection and model coordination. Review and resolve spatial, technical, installation, and constructability issues identified during design development and BIM coordination. Ensure design solutions are technically sound, constructible, cost-effective, and aligned with project specifications and approved design criteria. Generate material quantities, equipment schedules, and model-based reports from BIM models. Review technical submittals, material submissions, equipment data sheets, RFIs, and shop drawings for compliance with the approved design. Ensure designs, BIM models, and drawings comply with the Saudi Building Code, project specifications, applicable engineering standards, and BIM requirements. Support engineering, procurement, construction, and site teams with technical coordination, design clarifications, and model updates. Incorporate approved design changes, RFIs, site instructions, and redline markups into BIM models and construction drawings. Support project delivery throughout the design, coordination, construction, testing, commissioning, and as-built stages. Strong hands-on experience with Autodesk Revit MEP and related BIM tools is preferred. A background in construction or design-build projects will also be considered favorably.
